output.message: A premium modern digital marketing agency website.
output.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>Vertex — Digital Growth Agency</title>

    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #635bff;
            --primary-dark: #4f46e5;
            --accent: #14b8a6;

            --background: #f8fafc;
            --surface: #ffffff;
            --surface-dark: #111827;

            --text-primary: #111827;
            --text-secondary: #64748b;

            --border: #e2e8f0;

            --success: #10b981;
            --shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);

            --radius-sm: 12px;
            --radius-md: 20px;
            --radius-lg: 32px;

            --max-width: 1180px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family:
                Inter,
                -apple-system,
                BlinkMacSystemFont,
                "Segoe UI",
                sans-serif;

            background: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        a {
            color: inherit;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        button {
            font: inherit;
        }

        .container {
            width: min(calc(100% - 40px), var(--max-width));
            margin: auto;
        }

        /* =========================
           NAVBAR
        ========================= */

        .navbar {
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 1000;

            background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);

            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.7);
        }

        .nav-content {
            height: 78px;

            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;

            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -1px;
        }

        .logo-mark {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            border-radius: 11px;

            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;

            font-weight: 900;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 28px;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;

            transition: color 0.2s ease;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .nav-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .btn {
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;

            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 8px;

            padding: 13px 20px;

            border-radius: 10px;

            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 14px;

            transition:
                transform 0.2s ease,
                box-shadow 0.2s ease,
                background 0.2s ease;
        }

        .btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .btn-primary {
            color: white;
            background: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.25);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: var(--primary-dark);
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .mobile-menu-btn {
            display: none;

            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;

            background: white;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 20px;
        }

        /* =========================
           HERO
        ========================= */

        .hero {
            position: relative;
            padding: 110px 0 90px;

            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: "";

            position: absolute;
            width: 650px;
            height: 650px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background:
                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.15),
                    transparent 70%
                );

            top: -250px;
            right: -200px;

            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .hero-grid {
            position: relative;

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 70px;
        }

        .eyebrow {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;

            padding: 8px 12px;

            border: 1px solid rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 999px;

            color: var(--primary);
            background: rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.06);

            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .eyebrow-dot {
            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;

            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--success);
        }

        .hero h1 {
            margin-top: 22px;

            font-size: clamp(48px, 6vw, 76px);
            line-height: 1.04;
            letter-spacing: -4px;

            max-width: 760px;
        }

        .hero h1 span {
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .hero-description {
            margin-top: 24px;

            max-width: 600px;

            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .hero-actions {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 14px;

            margin-top: 32px;
        }

        .hero-meta {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 30px;

            margin-top: 38px;
        }

        .avatar-group {
            display: flex;
        }

        .avatar {
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            margin-left: -10px;

            border: 3px solid var(--background);

            color: white;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .avatar:first-child {
            margin-left: 0;
            background: #0f172a;
        }

        .avatar:nth-child(2) {
            background: #7c3aed;
        }

        .avatar:nth-child(3) {
            background: #0891b2;
        }

        .hero-rating {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .stars {
            color: #f59e0b;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        /* =========================
           DASHBOARD PREVIEW
        ========================= */

        .preview-card {
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            border-radius: 24px;

            padding: 20px;

            box-shadow: var(--shadow);

            transform: rotate(2deg);

            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .preview-card:hover {
            transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-5px);
        }

        .preview-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;

            margin-bottom: 22px;
        }

        .preview-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;

            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .preview-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;

            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--primary);
        }

        .status {
            padding: 6px 10px;

            background: #ecfdf5;
            color: #059669;

            border-radius: 999px;

            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .metric-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .metric {
            padding: 16px;

            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 14px;
        }

        .metric-label {
            font-size: 11px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .metric-value {
            margin-top: 6px;

            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -1px;
        }

        .metric-growth {
            margin-top: 4px;

            color: var(--success);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .chart {
            height: 190px;

            margin-top: 16px;
            padding: 20px;

            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: 12px;

            border-radius: 16px;

            background: #f8fafc;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .bar {
            flex: 1;

            min-height: 30px;

            border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px;

            background: linear-gradient(
                to top,
                var(--primary),
                #a5b4fc
            );

            transition:
                height 0.4s ease,
                opacity 0.2s ease;
        }

        .bar:hover {
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        /* =========================
           TRUST
        ========================= */

        .trust {
            padding: 35px 0;

            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

            background: white;
        }

        .trust p {
            text-align: center;

            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .logo-list {
            margin-top: 25px;

            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 45px;

            color: #94a3b8;

            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        /* =========================
           SECTIONS
        ========================= */

        section {
            padding: 110px 0;
        }

        .section-heading {
            max-width: 700px;
        }

        .section-label {
            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .section-heading h2 {
            margin-top: 12px;

            font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -2.5px;
        }

        .section-heading p {
            margin-top: 18px;

            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 17px;
        }

        /* =========================
           SERVICES
        ========================= */

        .services-grid {
            margin-top: 55px;

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .service-card {
            padding: 30px;

            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            border-radius: var(--radius-md);

            transition:
                transform 0.25s ease,
                box-shadow 0.25s ease,
                border-color 0.25s ease;
        }

        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            border-color: rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.35);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .service-icon {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            border-radius: 14px;

            background: rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.1);
            color: var(--primary);

            font-size: 22px;
        }

        .service-card h3 {
            margin-top: 24px;
            font-size: 20px;
        }

        .service-card p {
            margin-top: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .service-link {
            display: inline-block;

            margin-top: 20px;

            color: var(--primary);
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        /* =========================
           RESULTS
        ========================= */

        .results {
            background: var(--surface-dark);
            color: white;
        }

        .results .section-label {
            color: #a5b4fc;
        }

        .results .section-heading p {
            color: #94a3b8;
        }

        .stats-grid {
            margin-top: 55px;

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .stat-card {
            padding: 30px;

            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);

            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-size: 42px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -2px;
        }

        .stat-card p {
            margin-top: 8px;
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* =========================
           PROCESS
        ========================= */

        .process-grid {
            margin-top: 55px;

            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .process-step {
            position: relative;
            padding: 28px;

            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
        }

        .step-number {
            display: inline-flex;

            width: 34px;
            height: 34px;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;

            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .process-step h3 {
            margin-top: 22px;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .process-step p {
            margin-top: 10px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        /* =========================
           TESTIMONIAL
        ========================= */

        .testimonial-card {
            margin-top: 55px;

            padding: 55px;

            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

            background: white;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }

        .quote {
            max-width: 900px;

            font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 42px);
            line-height: 1.3;
            letter-spacing: -1.5px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .client {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;

            margin-top: 35px;
        }

        .client-avatar {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;

            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .client-info strong {
            display: block;
        }

        .client-info span {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        /* =========================
           CTA
        ========================= */

        .cta-box {
            padding: 70px;

            text-align: center;

            color: white;

            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

            background:
                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    #4f46e5,
                    #7c3aed
                );
        }

        .cta-box h2 {
            font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 60px);
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -2px;
        }

        .cta-box p {
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 20px auto 0;

            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
        }

        .cta-box .btn {
            margin-top: 30px;

            background: white;
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        /* =========================
           FOOTER
        ========================= */

        footer {
            padding: 45px 0;

            background: white;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .footer-content {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .footer-content p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .footer-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .footer-links a {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        /* =========================
           MOBILE
        ========================= */

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .nav-links,
            .nav-actions {
                display: none;
            }

            .mobile-menu-btn {
                display: block;
            }

            .nav-links.active {
                position: absolute;

                top: 78px;
                left: 20px;
                right: 20px;

                padding: 25px;

                display: flex;
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
                gap: 20px;

                background: white;
                border: 1px solid var(--border);
                border-radius: 16px;

                box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            }

            .hero {
                padding-top: 75px;
            }

            .hero-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .preview-card {
                transform: none;
            }

            .services-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }

            .process-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .container {
                width: min(calc(100% - 28px), var(--max-width));
            }

            .hero h1 {
                letter-spacing: -2.5px;
            }

            .hero-meta {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
                gap: 15px;
            }

            .services-grid,
            .stats-grid,
            .process-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .testimonial-card,
            .cta-box {
                padding: 32px 24px;
            }

            .footer-content {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }

            .footer-links {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>

    <!-- NAVIGATION -->

    <header class="navbar">

        <div class="container nav-content">

            <a href="#home" class="logo">

                <div class="logo-mark">V</div>

                Vertex

            </a>

            <nav class="nav-links" id="navLinks">

                <a href="#home">Home</a>
                <a href="#services">Services</a>
                <a href="#results">Results</a>
                <a href="#process">Process</a>
                <a href="#contact">Contact</a>

            </nav>

            <div class="nav-actions">

                <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-secondary">
                    Let's Talk
                </a>

                <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-primary">
                    Start Growing
                </a>

            </div>

            <button
                class="mobile-menu-btn"
                id="mobileMenuBtn"
                aria-label="Open navigation menu"
            >
                ☰
            </button>

        </div>

    </header>


    <!-- HERO -->

    <main>

        <section class="hero" id="home">

            <div class="container hero-grid">

                <div>

                    <div class="eyebrow">

                        <span class="eyebrow-dot"></span>

                        Growth systems built for ambitious brands

                    </div>

                    <h1>

                        Turn attention into
                        <span>measurable growth.</span>

                    </h1>

                    <p class="hero-description">

                        Vertex helps ambitious companies scale through
                        high-performance digital strategy, creative,
                        paid media and conversion optimization.

                    </p>

                    <div class="hero-actions">

                        <a href="#contact" class="btn btn-primary">

                            Book a Growth Strategy Call
                            →

                        </a>

                        <a href="#services" class="btn btn-secondary">

                            Explore Services

                        </a>

                    </div>

                    <div class="hero-meta">

                        <div class="avatar-group">

                            <div class="avatar">AM</div>
                            <div class="avatar">JS</div>
                            <div class="avatar">RK</div>

                        </div>

                        <div class="hero-rating">

                            <div class="stars">
                                ★★★★★
                            </div>

                            Trusted by growth-focused teams worldwide

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <!-- PRODUCT PREVIEW -->

                <div class="preview-card">

                    <div class="preview-top">

                        <div class="preview-brand">

                            <span class="preview-dot"></span>

                            Growth Overview

                        </div>

                        <span class="status">
                            ● Live
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <div class="metric-grid">

                        <div class="metric">

                            <div class="metric-label">
                                Revenue Generated
                            </div>

                            <div class="metric-value">
                                $2.48M
                            </div>

                            <div class="metric-growth">
                                ↑ 32.4%
                            </div>

                        </div>


                        <div class="metric">

                            <div class="metric-label">
                                Qualified Leads
                            </div>

                            <div class="metric-value">
                                18,420
                            </div>

                            <div class="metric-growth">
                                ↑ 18.7%
                            </div>

                        </div>

                    </div>


                    <div class="chart" id="heroChart">

                        <div class="bar" style="height: 42%"></div>
                        <div class="bar" style="height: 65%"></div>
                        <div class="bar" style="height: 50%"></div>
                        <div class="bar" style="height: 75%"></div>
                        <div class="bar" style="height: 60%"></div>
                        <div class="bar" style="height: 88%"></div>
                        <div class="bar" style="height: 72%"></div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- TRUST -->

        <section class="trust">

            <div class="container">

                <p>
                    BUILT FOR TEAMS THAT EXPECT MORE FROM DIGITAL
                </p>

                <div class="logo-list">

                    <span>ORBIT</span>
                    <span>NEXA</span>
                    <span>QUANTUM</span>
                    <span>NORTHSTAR</span>
                    <span>ASCEND</span>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- SERVICES -->

        <section id="services">

            <div class="container">

                <div class="section-heading">

                    <div class="section-label">
                        What we do
                    </div>

                    <h2>
                        One growth partner.
                        Multiple growth engines.
                    </h2>

                    <p>

                        We combine strategy, creative and technology
                        to build marketing systems designed to scale.

                    </p>

                </div>


                <div class="services-grid" id="servicesGrid"></div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- RESULTS -->

        <section class="results" id="results">

            <div class="container">

                <div class="section-heading">

                    <div class="section-label">
                        Our impact
                    </div>

                    <h2>
                        Growth measured in real business outcomes.
                    </h2>

                    <p>

                        We focus on performance metrics that matter:
                        revenue, demand, retention and sustainable growth.

                    </p>

                </div>


                <div class="stats-grid">

                    <div class="stat-card">

                        <div class="stat-number" data-target="240">
                            0
                        </div>

                        <p>
                            Million dollars in client revenue influenced
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <div class="stat-card">

                        <div class="stat-number" data-target="38">
                            0
                        </div>

                        <p>
                            Average percentage increase in qualified leads
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <div class="stat-card">

                        <div class="stat-number" data-target="120">
                            0
                        </div>

                        <p>
                            Growth campaigns successfully launched
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <div class="stat-card">

                        <div class="stat-number" data-target="94">
                            0
                        </div>

                        <p>
                            Client retention and partnership satisfaction
                        </p>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- PROCESS -->

        <section id="process">

            <div class="container">

                <div class="section-heading">

                    <div class="section-label">
                        Our process
                    </div>

                    <h2>
                        A structured path from strategy to scale.
                    </h2>

                </div>


                <div class="process-grid">

                    <div class="process-step">

                        <span class="step-number">01</span>

                        <h3>Discover</h3>

                        <p>
                            We understand your business,
                            audience and growth opportunities.
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <div class="process-step">

                        <span class="step-number">02</span>

                        <h3>Strategize</h3>

                        <p>
                            We build a focused growth roadmap
                            around measurable objectives.
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <div class="process-step">

                        <span class="step-number">03</span>

                        <h3>Execute</h3>

                        <p>
                            Our specialists launch and optimize
                            campaigns across the right channels.
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <div class="process-step">

                        <span class="step-number">04</span>

                        <h3>Scale</h3>

                        <p>
                            We identify winning systems and
                            expand what creates real impact.
                        </p>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- TESTIMONIAL -->

        <section>

            <div class="container">

                <div class="testimonial-card">

                    <p class="quote">

                        "Vertex completely changed how we think about
                        digital growth. Their combination of strategy,
                        creativity and performance delivered results
                        we could clearly measure."

                    </p>

                    <div class="client">

                        <div class="client-avatar">
                            JM
                        </div>

                        <div class="client-info">

                            <strong>
                                Jordan Mitchell
                            </strong>

                            <span>
                                VP of Growth, Nexa Technologies
                            </span>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- CTA -->

        <section id="contact">

            <div class="container">

                <div class="cta-box">

                    <h2>
                        Ready to build your next growth engine?
                    </h2>

                    <p>

                        Tell us where you are today and where you want
                        to go. We'll help you identify the highest-impact
                        opportunities.

                    </p>

                    <button
                        class="btn"
                        id="contactBtn"
                    >
                        Start the Conversation →
                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>

    </main>


    <!-- FOOTER -->

    <footer>

        <div class="container footer-content">

            <a href="#home" class="logo">

                <div class="logo-mark">
                    V
                </div>

                Vertex

            </a>

            <p>
                © <span id="year"></span>
                Vertex Digital. Built for growth.
            </p>

            <div class="footer-links">

                <a href="#services">Services</a>
                <a href="#results">Results</a>
                <a href="#process">Process</a>
                <a href="#contact">Contact</a>

            </div>

        </div>

    </footer>


    <script>

        /*
        ========================================
        SERVICES DATA
        ========================================
        */

        const services = [
            {
                icon: "◎",
                title: "Growth Strategy",
                description:
                    "Data-informed positioning, acquisition and growth strategies built around your business objectives."
            },
            {
                icon: "↗",
                title: "Performance Marketing",
                description:
                    "High-performance paid media campaigns designed to improve efficiency and scale profitable growth."
            },
            {
                icon: "◈",
                title: "Creative Systems",
                description:
                    "Premium creative and content systems that strengthen your brand and improve conversion."
            }
        ];


        /*
        ========================================
        RENDER SERVICES
        ========================================
        */

        const servicesGrid =
            document.getElementById("servicesGrid");

        services.forEach(service => {

            const card =
                document.createElement("article");

            card.className = "service-card";

            card.innerHTML = `
                <div class="service-icon">
                    ${service.icon}
                </div>

                <h3>
                    ${service.title}
                </h3>

                <p>
                    ${service.description}
                </p>

                <a
                    href="#contact"
                    class="service-link"
                >
                    Learn more →
                </a>
            `;

            servicesGrid.appendChild(card);

        });


        /*
        ========================================
        MOBILE NAVIGATION
        ========================================
        */

        const mobileMenuBtn =
            document.getElementById("mobileMenuBtn");

        const navLinks =
            document.getElementById("navLinks");


        mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                navLinks.classList.toggle("active");

                mobileMenuBtn.textContent =
                    navLinks.classList.contains("active")
                        ? "✕"
                        : "☰";

            }
        );


        document
            .querySelectorAll(".nav-links a")
            .forEach(link => {

                link.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    () => {

                        navLinks.classList.remove("active");

                        mobileMenuBtn.textContent = "☰";

                    }
                );

            });


        /*
        ========================================
        CONTACT BUTTON
        ========================================
        */

        document
            .getElementById("contactBtn")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                () => {

                    const email =
                        "hello@vertexdigital.com";

                    window.location.href =
                        `mailto:${email}?subject=Growth Strategy Consultation`;

                }
            );


        /*
        ========================================
        ANIMATED STATISTICS
        ========================================
        */

        const counters =
            document.querySelectorAll("[data-target]");

        let countersStarted = false;


        function animateCounters() {

            if (countersStarted) return;

            countersStarted = true;

            counters.forEach(counter => {

                const target =
                    Number(counter.dataset.target);

                const suffix =
                    target === 240
                        ? "M+"
                        : target === 38
                            ? "%"
                            : target === 94
                                ? "%"
                                : "+";

                let current = 0;

                const increment =
                    Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.ceil(target / 70)
                    );

                const timer =
                    setInterval(() => {

                        current += increment;

                        if (current >= target) {

                            current = target;

                            clearInterval(timer);

                        }

                        counter.textContent =
                            current + suffix;

                    }, 25);

            });

        }


        const resultsSection =
            document.getElementById("results");


        const observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(
                entries => {

                    entries.forEach(entry => {

                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                            animateCounters();

                        }

                    });

                },
                {
                    threshold: 0.3
                }
            );


        observer.observe(resultsSection);


        /*
        ========================================
        DYNAMIC YEAR
        ========================================
        */

        document.getElementById("year").textContent =
            new Date().getFullYear();


        /*
        ========================================
        INTERACTIVE HERO CHART
        ========================================
        */

        const bars =
            document.querySelectorAll(".bar");


        bars.forEach(bar => {

            const originalHeight =
                bar.style.height;

            bar.addEventListener(
                "mouseenter",
                () => {

                    bar.style.height =
                        "100%";

                }
            );

            bar.addEventListener(
                "mouseleave",
                () => {

                    bar.style.height =
                        originalHeight;

                }
            );

        });

    </script>

</body>
</html>
